description: A deterministic, wholly synthetic snapshot designed to demonstrate settlement reconciliation. Scenario outcomes are injected test fixtures, not real incidents or business claims.

scenarios.name: Normal daily close
scenarios.description: A clean Services/EUR close used as the control case.

scenarios.name: Delayed Travel / GBP batch
scenarios.description: A Travel batch settles three calendar days beyond each merchant's applicable SLA.

scenarios.name: Stale Electronics / EUR fee schedule
scenarios.description: Recorded fees use the prior schedule after new effective-dated merchant terms begin.

scenarios.name: Missing Retail / CAD batch
scenarios.description: A completed Retail batch has no settlement evidence after its SLA expires.
